topics.name: action
topics.description: Trade direction — Buy or Sell. Also known as 'order side'.

topics.name: alertStatus
topics.description: Lifecycle status of an alert returned by `list_alerts` / used as filter.

topics.name: alert_expression_dsl
topics.description: create_alert mode B: an arbitrary boolean expression over contract / position / account numeric functions combined with arithmetic, comparison, and AND/OR/XOR logic. Fires when the expression evaluates to true. Each function takes a subject — contract symbol for contract functions (e.g. "ESM6"), account-qualified symbol for position functions (the server resolves your account), account name for account functions.

topics.name: barType
topics.description: Bar aggregation type for `market_history`.

topics.name: cancel_order_examples
topics.description: Example cancel_order invocations.

topics.name: cancel_order_output
topics.description: Shape of cancel_order response — per-order cancel results plus the total remaining working-order count.

topics.name: cashChangeType
topics.description: Type of cash-balance change on the account ledger. Used as a filter on cash_history.cashChangeType and appears in each cash-history row.

topics.name: cash_history_output
topics.description: Shape of cash_history response — ledger-level cash changes.

topics.name: close_position_examples
topics.description: Example close_position invocations.

topics.name: close_position_output
topics.description: Shape of close_position response — per-position close results plus the total remaining position count.

topics.name: create_alert_examples
topics.description: Example create_alert invocations for both modes (simple price cross, expression DSL).

topics.name: create_alert_output
topics.description: Shape of create_alert response — echoes the new alert with its assigned id.

topics.name: daily_balance_history_output
topics.description: Shape of daily_balance_history response — one row per trading day.

topics.name: dom_snapshot_output
topics.description: Shape of dom_snapshot response — depth-of-market snapshot for a single contract.

topics.name: environment_isolation
topics.description: Multi-environment (live + demo) stickiness rule. One server hosts one environment; every call in a workflow must stay on the server that owns the referenced account.

topics.name: estimate_order_examples
topics.description: Example estimate_order invocations — pre-flight margin/fees/permissions check.

topics.name: estimate_order_output
topics.description: Shape of estimate_order response — pre-flight feasibility check with fee and margin projection.

topics.name: fields
topics.description: Field-name → meaning index. Semantics shared across tools. Use describe(topic='fields') to get the full index.

topics.name: fill_history_output
topics.description: Shape of fill_history response — one row per fill.

topics.name: list_alerts_output
topics.description: Shape of list_alerts response — all alerts for the authenticated user.

topics.name: market_history_examples
topics.description: Example market_history invocations.

topics.name: market_history_output
topics.description: Shape of market_history response — OHLC bars with optional volume histogram.

topics.name: market_snapshot_output
topics.description: Shape of market_snapshot response — live quote + contract spec for each requested symbol.

topics.name: modify_order_examples
topics.description: Example modify_order invocations — partial updates.

topics.name: modify_order_output
topics.description: Shape of modify_order response — echoes the new values plus status.

topics.name: my_portfolio_output
topics.description: Shape of my_portfolio response — account summary, open positions, and working orders.

topics.name: ordStatus
topics.description: Order lifecycle status. Use on `order_history` filter or read on response rows.

topics.name: orderType
topics.description: Order type. Determines how and when the order executes relative to market price.

topics.name: order_details_output
topics.description: Shape of order_details response — full event history and fills for a single order.

topics.name: order_history_output
topics.description: Shape of order_history response — one row per order with current status + fill detail.

topics.name: place_order_examples
topics.description: Common place_order invocation patterns, including brackets.

topics.name: place_order_output
topics.description: Shape of place_order response — the outcome of a single order submission, echoes input plus server-assigned ID / status / strategy.

topics.name: position_history_output
topics.description: Shape of position_history response — one row per round-trip position pairing.

topics.name: productType
topics.description: Product category filter for `search_contracts`.

topics.name: pulse_examples
topics.description: Example pulse invocations — community sentiment snapshot.

topics.name: pulse_output
topics.description: Shape of pulse response — community sentiment snapshot for a topic/key.

topics.name: response_fields
topics.description: Optional `fields` input on my_portfolio, market_snapshot, user_profile. An array of dotted paths — the server prunes the response to only those paths. Agents that only need one or two fields out of a large response should always use this.

topics.name: response_format
topics.description: Supported `format` input on history tools (fill_history, order_history, position_history, cash_history, daily_balance_history). Controls the shape of the response body — default is 'objects' for backward compatibility.

topics.name: resultStatus
topics.description: Per-row result status on multi-target operations (place_order, cancel_order, close_position, modify_order). Indicates whether that row succeeded, was rejected by risk, was blocked, or failed for a system reason.

topics.name: risk_settings_output
topics.description: Shape of risk_settings and update_risk_settings responses — the per-account risk configuration.

topics.name: search_contracts_examples
topics.description: Example search_contracts invocations.

topics.name: search_contracts_output
topics.description: Shape of search_contracts response — matched contracts with product metadata.

topics.name: timeInForce
topics.description: Order duration / time-in-force.

topics.description: How the trailing max-drawdown floor is updated.

topics.description: Alert trigger condition.

topics.name: user_profile_output
